messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx + DNS timeouts observed from eu-west-2a (AZc) affecting egress flows to external scoring endpoints. Aggregated error rate 21% across canaries. Paging oncall.
Maria (oncall): I'm on it. starting triage. any recent deploys or infra changes? :thinking_face:
Kevin (infra): We pushed a canary SG/NACL sync 5m ago to align rules across AZs. I rolled the config via terraform in eu-west-2.
Josh (eng-runtime): seeing timeouts from runtime machines in AZc to score.example.com:53 and to 3rd-party APIs on 443. traceroute from runtime -> stops at NAT gateway IP.
Leo (sre): can you paste traceroute and iptables?
Josh (eng-runtime): ```
traceroute to score.example.com (35.204.12.9), 30 hops max, 1 ms avg
1 10.0.4.1
2 10.0.2.1
3 169.254.169.254
4 52.95.10.5 * *
```
Josh (eng-runtime): iptables looks normal. conntrack shows many SYN_RECV to external IPs.
Kevin (infra): suspect NACL applied to the private subnet by mistake. I accidentally used the eu-west-2b NACL id in the association step for the AZc subnet when running the plan. Looking now.
Maria (oncall): if NACL is denying ephemeral ports then return path is broken — explain cross-AZ allowed?
Kevin (infra): Right now the route table is fine. It's the NACL blocking ephemeral egress (1024-65535) for UDP/TCP. I can revert association.
Support-Alex: We have customer reports: support queue shows 12 tickets saying 'model scoring timeout' starting ~03:07 UTC. Oncall page shows increased errors for users in EU.
Maria (oncall): Impact estimate: partial degradation for eu-west-2a only. Canaries tripped and some traffic was routed to canary fallback but not all.
Leo (sre): Mitigation plan: 1) Disassociate incorrect NACL from subnet, 2) Re-associate correct permissive NACL, 3) If that fails, modify NACL rules to open ephemeral ports, 4) Failover routes to eu-west-2b NAT as temporary.
Kevin (infra): I'm executing rollback: `terraform apply -target=aws_subnet_network_acl_association.errassoc -var='env=prod'`
Kevin (infra): ```Applying...
- aws_subnet_network_acl_association.errassoc: Destroying... done
```
Kevin (infra): Re-association removed. Testing now.
Josh (eng-runtime): Running curl to scoring endpoint from a runtime in AZc: initial requests failing with ECONNRESET, now starting to succeed. 6/6 requests ok.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Alert update: error rate reduced to 2.3% in eu-west-2a. Monitoring for 15m.
Maria (oncall): Confirming DNS lookups are returning again from AZc. `dig score.example.com` returns 35.204.12.9
Support-Alex: Notifying customers: sent templated message to impacted tenant cohort.
Leo (sre): Post-incident immediate actions: - revert infra change and audit deployment gating, - add preflight check to verify NACL associations in canary are identical by AZ, - add a rollback runbook for network-assoc mistakes.
Kevin (infra): Root cause note: human operator used wrong var for `subnet_id` in a partial apply, associating eu-west-2b NACL to 2a subnet; plan looked ok because name tags overlapped.
Maria (oncall): Time timeline: 03:05 UTC NACL apply, 03:07 UTC canaries trigger, 03:13 UTC rollback complete, 03:18 UTC customer impact largely cleared. Impact window ~13 minutes.
Josh (eng-runtime): Added temporary metric to track per-AZ DNS latency and egress port failures.
Maria (oncall): Handoff to next oncall Leo for post-incident follow-up and postmortem. Summary for handoff: egress blocked due to wrong NACL association during canary rollout; rollback removed association; customers affected for ~13m; tickets opened; mitigation steps and follow-ups listed above.
Leo (sre): ack, taking over. I'll coordinate postmortem and ensure ops guardrails (tagging, preflight, policy) are implemented.
incident-bot: :information_source: Handoff: oncall changes to Leo at 03:22 UTC. Incident channel will remain for postmortem notes.
Maria (oncall): thanks team :heart: closing active paging.
Kevin (infra): I'll open a PR to add an explicit association-check to the terraform pipeline and add a required review by infra-owner before apply.
Support-Alex: I'll follow up with customers who reported timeouts and update the internal status page.
Leo (sre): filing postmortem ticket and assigning owners. Expected doc by EOD tomorrow.
